title: [spec-gap][R-ADR-018] Kconfig symbols CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP16 and CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_SLOTS=8 named by appendix 7.6 do not exist
description: spec/appendix-design-rationale.md:423-425 requires CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP16=y, CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_SLOTS=8, CONFIG_LICHEN_ADAPTIVE_SF=y. Only CONFIG_LICHEN_ADAPTIVE_SF exists (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/Kconfig:164-168, default y; inner symbol lichen/subsys/lichen/Kconfig:37-46). CONFIG_LICHEN_CCP16 and CONFIG_LICHEN_TDMA_SLOTS have zero Kconfig occurrences (sole repo occurrences are the appendix lines themselves). Nearest real symbols: CONFIG_LICHEN_LINK_CCP16_LOAD_BALANCING (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig:148-149, bool, no default y — tracked b7z9.177) and LICHEN_TDMA* booleans (link/Kconfig:160-236, no slot-count int). Found during appendix-design-rationale sweep. Suggested: add the two symbols (int default 8 for slot count, gate for CCP-16) or amend the appendix to name the real symbols.
